likely_cause: Partition too large; large object accumulation
diagnostic: Check partition size: df.rdd.getNumPartitions(); executor memory in Spark UI
fix: repartition(n) where n = data_GB * 8; reduce object size

likely_cause: Key skew in groupBy or join
fix: Salt the skewed key; or broadcast join the smaller side

diagnostic: spark.sql.shuffle.partitions default is 200 — often too low

likely_cause: collect() or toPandas() on large dataset
fix: Write to storage; use show(n) for samples; never collect large dataset

symptom: Shuffle too slow — too many small files
diagnostic: Check output file count after write
fix: Use coalesce(n) before write to reduce output files; enable AQE

diagnostic: Check GC time in Spark UI > 10%
fix: Reduce partition size; use off-heap memory; persist intermediate DataFrames

likely_cause: Last few tasks take 10x longer (speculative needed)
diagnostic: Check Spark UI stage view for straggler tasks

likely_cause: JDBC URL wrong; connection pool exhausted
fix: Reduce numPartitions on JDBC read; increase CH connection pool
